2131. Sum of All Elements in a 2D Matrix

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a matrix of size M x N and print the sum of all its elements, using nested loops.

Description
Read two integers M and N representing the number of rows and columns. Read M x N integers into a two-dimensional array using nested loops. Use another pair of nested loops to add up every element of the matrix into a running sum, and print the final sum.
input_spec: Two integers M and N, followed by M x N integers given row by row.
output_spec: Print the sum of all elements in the matrix.
